current_view_hints.core_warning: This is a working convention cluster, not a theorem. It records the interpretation that existing direct Kirby-link evaluations are best viewed as using an upside-down / dual Kirby picture relative to Tham Definition 5.11.
current_view_hints.special_dotted_knots: If the original Kirby diagram has special dotted knots, then in this Tham-5.11-compatible dual reading they should more naturally be interpreted as 3-handle / vacuum-channel projection data rather than ordinary 1-handles for the current framed-link evaluator.

display_name: Dual Kirby-link evaluation convention working cluster
scope_note: Working-understanding cluster for relating existing direct Kirby-link evaluations to Tham's premodular handle-by-handle skein maps. The current interpretation is that existing evaluations are best read through an upside-down / dual Kirby-link convention: Tham's bottom-up 2-handle belt-core graph is viewed from the 4-handle side as a dual Kirby link. This avoids treating missing primal meridian insertions as an error, but remains a convention clarification and design hypothesis rather than a proved theorem.
upstream_review_hints: Future evaluator and formula work should distinguish primal attaching-link diagrams from upside-down / dual Kirby-link diagrams.
Do not inflate this cluster into a theorem-level equivalence between primal attaching-link evaluation and literal Tham belt-core evaluation.
Use the linked lab note as the normative record of the current working interpretation and its caveats.
